shared_elements: repeated small figural signs arranged in ordered rows/registers
elements of roughly uniform size repeated across the surface
justification: A shows a dense grid of compartmented block-like glyph signs in rigid stacked rows on a columnar surface, while B shows loosely scattered stick-like human figures with raised arms, boat-like crescents with crew strokes, a wheel/disc and quadruped-like forms across an open rock face. The only real correspondence is that both use small, highly schematic repeated motifs, which is generic; their subject matter (abstract sign-blocks vs narrative figures, boats and animals) and their organisation (strict register grid vs free field) differ fundamentally.
